Open policies and unreviewed surfaces remain incomplete.

lenses.name: raw primitives
lenses.trace: The 63-byte capacity and bounded u8 length are safe in selected safe constructors. The separate catalog validator repeats the syntax policy.

findings.relationship: Existing f2c 95e newly assessed ledger entry 2; not a new unique defect count. The separate id_type wrapper admission issue is related by pattern, not an established alias.
findings.evidence: Source interpretation: a public runtime-callable from_static("Bad value") produces a value serialized as that text while deserialization's try_new rejects it. No parser execution or supported production ingress was established.
findings.discovery: bounded; external calls, other interfaces, persisted input, policies and global aliases remain open
findings.proposed_connected_repair: Use one const-compatible byte-language predicate for from_static and try_new within the shared macro; retain all four existing types and their representation. Both paths require 1-63 bytes of lowercase ASCII, digits or _-.:. Keep try_new fallible and from_static asserting; valid unknown IDs remain allowed.
findings.acceptance: The two constructors accept the same 1-63-byte grammar. Invalid runtime from_static calls assert and invalid const uses fail constant evaluation; try_new and serde return errors. Valid unknown IDs, canonical bytes, length-first ordering, string serde, and selected generation behavior remain unchanged. Current constants compile and applicable quality gates pass. Negative constructor behavior is not directly covered by an object-focused unit test under the repository rule; source proof and actual validation limits must be recorded.

open_questions.detail: Derived length-first circumstance ordering and explicitly lexical incident ordering differ; selected outbreak code takes the first set item. The intended policy and reachable consequence remain open; preserve current order in this repair.

No exact alias or result is established.
